limits: All risk and wallet/quote observations are explicit artificial fixtures. No real risk authority, broker wallet/quote feed, forward schedule or strategy profitability is validated.
Checks and subsequent fake transport are not atomic against arbitrary concurrent mutation. There is no guarantee against future price gaps, fee-rule changes or real broker fills.
Artificial USDT initial50/floor30 is not a user CNY/FX risk budget. Projected NAV is conditional on the fixed snapshot/reference and fee bound, not future account NAV.

Separate signal-registry/order-journal commits conservatively lose permission on crash; never automatically refund or regenerate it. Deletion/copy/new journals and arbitrary same-UID mutation are outside retained-file integrity.
Once-only state is per retained artificial registry/intent, not account-global. No portfolio-global sticky breach history or continuous live risk engine is implemented.
After a captured account, different latest wallet values require matching fresh evidence; this minimal runner blocks rather than refreshing or resizing the frozen order.
Only BTC BUY and quote-USDT fees; no SELL/ETH/rotation/base-fee/BNB-fee order execution, continuous scheduler, cancel flow or new partial-fill model.
This producer report is not independent acceptance; independent auditor will attack frozen source/test/report before any broader admission. Existing real probe budgets are not reused.
